hero.title: Leading the Nation in Cranberry Production
hero.description: Wisconsin is the leading cranberry-producing state in the nation, with a proud history of family farms, groundbreaking research, and environmental stewardship spanning over 170 years.
hero.imageAlt: Aerial view of Wisconsin cranberry harvest with vibrant red cranberries floating in flooded bogs

mission.title: Investing in Wisconsin's Cranberry Future
mission.paragraph1: Funded by grower assessments and led by a board of elected Wisconsin cranberry growers, the Wisconsin Cranberry Board invests in projects that benefit growers, strengthen markets, and support long-term industry success.
mission.paragraph2: Established in 1983, the Board operates under state statute and is administered by the Wisconsin Department of Agriculture, Trade and Consumer Protection (DATCP). Through strategic reinvestment of grower assessment funds, we advance research, education, and promotion initiatives that keep Wisconsin at the forefront of cranberry production.
mission.imageAlt: Freshly harvested Wisconsin cranberries in collection bins at a cranberry marsh

pillars.title: Research & Innovation
pillars.description: Funds cutting-edge research to improve production practices, sustainability, pest management, and crop quality for Wisconsin growers.

pillars.title: Promotion & Education
pillars.description: Supports efforts that build demand and increase consumer understanding of Wisconsin cranberries and their many health benefits.

pillars.title: Industry Advancement
pillars.description: Invests in projects that strengthen the future of Wisconsin's cranberry industry through innovation and long-term strategic planning.

pillars.title: Stewardship
pillars.description: Encourages responsible growing practices and environmental care across Wisconsin's 20,000+ acres of cranberry production.
